content:
Lyrics：（造语部分省略）

The Vast
Come from afar（1） in twilight
You come within my eyesight
We search everywhere
Elysium（2）lies there

Every tear melts in daylight
Bless me with all your might
We search nowhere
Eternity lies here

Let me fly up to hill
 fly down to vale
On never-ending skyline

Hug me tight in eulogy
 tight in elegy（3）
The vast is in mine
Hold my hands in thine（4）

Kiss me goodbye in twilight
Waning light shining bright
We search nowhere
Infinity lies here
For aye
In mine
